scope.objective: Use one immutable post-tool working-tree observation for every consumer of an event and bind exact configured verifier proof to stable pre, post, and current working-tree evidence.

productionTree.canonicalization: UTF-8 sorted production paths from the FS0 constitution; JSON array of {path,mode,size,sha256}; aggregate SHA-256 is domain plus canonical JSON bytes

preArtifactWorkingTreeObservation.disposition: Dirty user-owned development tree retained. Exact production identity is local implementation evidence only; no clean or frozen release candidate is claimed.

oneObservationContract.captureBoundary: Each active-task tool_result consumes the authorized shell pre-snapshot, captures one immutable UTF-8-sorted post-event working-tree observation, and passes that same object to every event consumer.
oneObservationContract.immutability: The supplied snapshot is cloned, sorted, frozen, and digested once. Mutation of the caller's input or the workspace after capture cannot change the event observation.
oneObservationContract.unavailableDisposition: Snapshots containing unavailable carrier evidence produce a wt-content-v2-unavailable aggregate and are never proof-capable verifier evidence.

exactVerifierContract.pre: The authorized exact configured shell verifier captures its proof-capable tree before execution.
exactVerifierContract.post: The tool-result event supplies its single proof-capable post observation; verifier recording does not resnapshot.
exactVerifierContract.current: Completion re-evaluates the current working tree and accepts proof only when each configured verifier's latest execution has pre == post == current.
exactVerifierContract.ordering: Latest observedAt/recordedAt evidence for every configured command wins; a later failure cannot be hidden by an earlier pass and each command must be stable on the same current digest.
exactVerifierContract.checkpointIdentity: Journal idempotency binds command, pre digest, post digest, exit code, and observed time so stable and unstable executions cannot alias.

carrierMatrix.evidence: The current-tree snapshot contains both modified tracked files and newly created untracked files with independent wt-content-v2 identities.
Changing only a regular file mode changes its current-tree file digest.
The digest binds the link target path without following or hashing external target bytes; changing the target changes the link evidence.
An unchanged unavailable file has stable inventory evidence but its aggregate is explicitly unavailable and not proof-capable.
A behavioral tool-result test mutates the workspace inside the first consumer and proves all later consumers still receive the same frozen event observation.
Per-command pre/post/current stability and latest-result semantics remain enforced; otherwise identical checkpoints with a different pre digest are distinct while exact duplicates remain idempotent.
